Calculate RF-EMF Dose from Smart Watch (watch contribution only)

smartwatch_watch_dose.Rd

Calculates the tissue-specific RF-EMF dose from smart-watch use (watch contribution only).

Usage

smartwatch_watch_dose(tissue, duration_smartwatch, params = load_params())

Arguments

tissue

Tissue for which to calculate dose (default: "brain" or "body")

duration_smartwatch

duration of time smart-watch was worn in s/day

params

Parameter list (optional). If not specified, calculations use default parameters.

Value

Tissue-specific RF-EMF dose from smart-watch use (watch contribution only) in mJ/kg/day

Details

The RF-EMF dose from smart-watch use (watch contribution) is calculated as:

$$Dose_{watch} = nSAR_{watch} \times (P_{active} \times t_{active} + P_{passive} \times t_{passive})$$

Where:

  • \(nSAR_{watch}\) is the normalized SAR of the watch in W/kg/W

  • \(P_{active}\) and \(P_{passive}\) are the output powers of the watch in mW when transmitting actively and passively

  • \(t_{active}\) and \(t_{passive}\) are the times of active and passive transmission in s/day

While worn, the smart-watch transfers data for watch_transfer_dur seconds per day of wearing. During the share watch_transfer_active_prop of this time it transmits actively, the rest of the time passively (parameters of the device smartwatch):

$$t_{active} = duration \times T_{transfer} / 86400 \times f_{active}$$ $$t_{passive} = duration - t_{active}$$

with \(duration\) the time the watch is worn in s/day, \(T_{transfer}\) the transfer time (watch_transfer_dur) in s per day of wearing and \(f_{active}\) the active share (watch_transfer_active_prop).

Examples

smartwatch_watch_dose(
  tissue              = "body",
  duration_smartwatch = 6000)
